claims.object_text: quinidine therapy resulted in ≥50% seizure reduction in 20 patients
claims.quote: Records of 80 patients with 33 KCNT1 mutations were analysed, of which 20 patients had gained ≥50% seizure reduction due to quinidine therapy.

claims.object_text: variable response to quinidine among patients with the same mutation
claims.quote: quinidine therapy often had different effects on patients with the same KCNT1 mutation.

claims.object_text: age, genotypes, seizure types and brain MRI did not significantly influence quinidine effect
claims.quote: Age, genotypes of KCNT1 mutations, seizure types and brain MRI did not significantly influence the therapeutic effect of quinidine.

claims.object_text: prolonged QTc is the most common adverse event with quinidine
claims.quote: Prolonged QTc was the most common among all adverse events with quinidine.

claims.object_text: in vitro quinidine tests did not correspond with in vivo tests
claims.quote: Notably, results of in vitro quinidine tests did not correspond with in vivo tests.

claims.object_text: molecular insensitivity predicts clinical inefficacy for the same mutation
claims.quote: Insensitivity to quinidine by a certain Kcnt1 genotype in molecular tests is predictive of its inefficacy in human populations of the respective mutation.
